units.source_text: 岛村仍握住她的手不放，猛地从被窝里爬出来，

en.t: Shimamura still held her hand and, without letting go, suddenly climbed out from under the bedding,

units.source_text: 走到窗边，俯视她所说的登上来的地方，

en.t: went to the window and looked down at the place where she said she had climbed up,

units.source_text: 只见茂密的灌木丛尽头，展现一片繁衍生息的山白竹林。

en.t: and there, beyond the dense thicket of shrubs, a flourishing grove of mountain bamboo spread out.

units.source_text: 那地方是毗连松林的小丘半腰，

en.t: The place was halfway up a low hill adjoining a pine grove,

units.source_text: 窗跟前的地里种满了萝卜、甘薯、葱、芋头等，

en.t: and in the field right before the window, radishes, sweet potatoes, green onions, taro, and the like were planted thickly,

units.source_text: 虽是一般蔬菜，但洒上了朝阳，

en.t: and though they were ordinary vegetables, once the morning sun fell on them,

units.source_text: 叶子呈现出五光十色，给人一种初见的新鲜之感。

en.t: the leaves took on many colors, giving an impression of freshness as if seen for the first time.
